articles.author: Sarah Perez
articles.title: ChatGPT can now virtually try on clothes for you - techcrunch.com
articles.description: OpenAI is rolling out new shopping features for ChatGPT that let users virtually try on clothing and accessories using their own photos and save products they like to a Favorites library.
articles.content: OpenAI is again experimenting with how its conversational AI assistant, ChatGPT, can help users as they shop online. On Thursday, the company announced the global launch of two new shopping features,… [+2256 chars]
